caption:
It's been a while since Koko last exercised. That's okay.

Whether it's been a year or ten, getting back into exercise is often harder in your head than in your body. The trick is starting smaller than you think, so you leave each session feeling like you could do more.

Clinical Pilates can be a steady way back in. Sessions start with an assessment and build gradually. Mild muscle soreness early on usually eases within a few days. Twice a week plus a couple of walks is a solid start.

If you have a heart or lung condition or get chest pain with effort, check with your GP first. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio would love to help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
